jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role
Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer
Level: I3
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Working model: Hybrid (2–3 days/week in the office)

We’re looking for a Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer who thrives in complexity, precision and enjoys turning technical systems into simple, elegant user experiences. You’ll be part of Logitech’s Global User Experience team, supporting both the Gaming and Personal Workspace categories — two of the company’s most dynamic and fast-evolving business groups.

This is a unique hybrid role combining:

• Hardware Product User Experience design on platform topics such as connectivity and product behavior. You will create guidelines to harmonize experiences across products.

• Keyboard layout design , requiring high attention to detail, precision, and strong visual craft.

You are a systems thinker with strong product instincts, equally comfortable designing high-level architecture and crafting pixel-perfect layouts. You care deeply about how things work—not just how they look—and you’re motivated by solving real user problems across hardware and software.

Responsibilities
Product & Platform Experience

• Design end-to-end product experiences across hardware interactions with firmware and software in mind

• Contribute to platform-level UX topics (e.g., connectivity, device behaviors, system interactions)

• Translate complex technical constraints into clear, intuitive user experiences

• Define information architecture and interaction models for complex systems

Keyboard Layout Design

• Own and design complex keyboard layouts across multiple products, operating systems, and regions

• Create precise, production-ready layout files with strong attention to detail

• Ensure consistency across languages, markets, and product lines

• Collaborate closely with hardware, engineering, and localization teams to align on constraints

• Maintain and evolve standards, guidelines, and assets for keyboard layouts

Logitech Design System Contribution

• Contribute to the evolution of the Logitech Design System

• Define and document platform (e.g., Bluetooth Connectivity) and product guidelines (e.g., Webcam guidelines)

• Ensure alignment between design and engineering implementation (design ↔ firmware engineering)

• Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across products and platforms

• Actively contribute to consistency across Logitech product experiences

• Collaborate with design system and platform teams to improve reusability and quality

Key Qualifications
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
Design & Systems Thinking

• Strong experience designing complex consumer hardware products

• Strong portfolio showcasing hardware design solutions (e.g., consumer electronics, mobile, ergonomic products, etc.)

• Ability to translate product work into reusable guidelines

• Deep understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies

Craft & Execution

• Strong visual and interaction design skills with a high bar for quality and detail

• Excellent understanding of typography, layout and visual hierarchy

• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to deliver production-ready assets

• Understanding of localization challenge, typography, and spatial constraints

Tools & Technical

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator

• Experience with Figma

• 3D application is a plus

Collaboration & Communication

• Experience working closely with engineering and product teams

• Strong storytelling and presentation skills

• Strong in communication with multiple stakeholders and teams

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and fast-paced environments

Life at Logitech

Logitech is the sweet spot for people passionate about products, making a mark, and having fun doing it. As a company, we’re small and flexible enough for every person to take initiative and make things happen. But we’re big enough in our portfolio, and reach, for those actions to have a global impact. That’s a pretty sweet spot; we always strive to keep it that way.

Across Logitech, we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere without compromising on productivity or continuity, so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, teams or departments may split between working remotely and in-house.

Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer Livello: I3 Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera Modello di lavoro: Hybrid (2.3 giorni/settimana in ufficio)

Stiamo cercando un Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer che prosperi in complessità, precisione e goda di trasformare i sistemi tecnici in semplici ed eleganti esperienze utente. Sarete parte del team Logitech.s Global User Experience, supportando sia le categorie Gaming che Personal Workspace. due delle aziende più dinamiche e in rapida evoluzione gruppi di business.

Questo è un ruolo ibrido unico che combina:

- Hardware Product User Experience design su temi di piattaforma come connettività e behavior di prodotto. Creerai linee guida per armonizzare le esperienze tra i prodotti. - Keyboard layout design, che richiede un'alta attenzione ai dettagli, precisione e forte artigianato visivo.

Esperienza di prodotto e piattaforma

- Layout di tastiera complessi propri e di progettazione su più prodotti, sistemi operativi e regioni - Creare file di layout precisi e produttivi con una forte attenzione ai dettagli - Garantire coerenza tra linguaggi, mercati e linee di prodotto - Collaborare strettamente con i team di hardware, ingegneria e localizzazione per allineare i vincoli - Mantenere ed evolvere standard, linee guida e asset per layout di tastiera

Contributo del sistema di progettazione Logitech

- Contribuire all'evoluzione del Logitech Design System - Piattaforma di fine e documenti (ad esempio, Bluetooth Connectivity) e linee guida sui prodotti (ad esempio, Linee guida Webcam) - Garantire l'allineamento tra progettazione e implementazione ingegneristica (design ↔ firmware engineering) - Identificare le opportunità di standardizzare e scalare le soluzioni tra prodotti e piattaforme - Contribuire attivamente alla coerenza tra le esperienze di prodotto Logitech - Collaborare con i team di progettazione e piattaforma per migliorare la riutilizzabilità e la qualità

Qualificazioni chiave

Pensare al design e ai sistemi

- Forte esperienza nella progettazione di prodotti hardware complessi per i consumatori - Forte portafoglio di soluzioni hardware per la progettazione (ad esempio, elettronica di consumo, mobile, prodotti ergonomici, ecc.) - Capacità di tradurre il lavoro dei prodotti in linee guida riutilizzabili - Approfondimento dei principi e delle metodologie di progettazione dei centri di ricerca degli utenti

Artigianato ed esecuzione

- Forte capacità di progettazione visiva e di interazione con un alto bar per qualità e dettaglio - Ottima comprensione della tipografia, layout e gerarchia visiva - Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di fornire risorse produttive-ready - Comprensione della sfida di localizzazione, tipografia e vincoli spaziali

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role and Team:
As an Audio Machine Learning Data Engineer on the Logitech Hardware Audio Machine Learning and DSP Product team, you will work on developing and managing our audio datasets and data pipelines. This work directly influences the innovative audio experiences we deliver to our customers.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Data Pipeline Management: Ensuring the integrity and quality of Audio Machine Learning data pipelines and datasets, which involves robust data augmentation and managing workflows for supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised Machine Learning audio applications.

• Model Development and Deployment: Collaborating with the team to develop and deploy Audio Machine Learning models, specifically targeting platforms with strict resource limitations (such as Tensilica DSP, ARM, and RISC-V).

• Design and manage audio data collection, curation, labeling, cleaning and augmentation pipelines

• Evaluate and implement scalable data augmentation techniques.

• Establish and maintain high-quality, well-versioned, and documented datasets essential for training, validation, and benchmarking of audio Machine Learning models.

• Build automated tools for monitoring and ensuring the quality and statistical diversity of audio data.

• Formulate and execute strategies for continuous improvement of existing datasets.

Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• Audio Data Expertise: A minimum of 3 years of direct experience working with extensive audio datasets, including advanced data augmentation and preprocessing techniques audio Machine Learning.

• Python Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Python for both Machine Learning model development and automating data pipelines.

• Data Pipelines and Machine Learning Frameworks: Proven expertise in building scalable data pipelines and expertise in employing Machine Learning frameworks (TensorFlow, Keras) with large-scale, complex datasets

Preferred Qualifications:

• Expert-level skills in audio analysis, including listening and artifact detection, with a proven track record of validating performance across diverse datasets.

• Strong familiarity with designing, executing, and statistically analyzing audio quality measurement protocols, specializing in managing data-driven objective and subjective evaluations.

• A strong data-first mindset, with a demonstrated ability to drive innovation both independently and as part of a team.

• Proficiency in C and SQL, along with experience using code version control systems (Git), is a valuable asset.

• Excellent cross-functional communication, documentation, and leadership skills, emphasizing transparency in data and results.

The Role:
As a Senior Sourcing Specialist, you will play a crucial role in executing sourcing processes for electromechanical components, managing supplier relationships, and driving cost efficiencies. The focus will be on strategic sourcing and supplier management, including negotiations, contracting, and supplier performance. You will need to collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with company goals and market trends.

- Manage sourcing for electronic mechanical components.
- Oversee supplier management and negotiate pricing and contracts.
- Lead new supplier selection and vendor management.
- Drive cost reduction strategies and identify sourcing opportunities.
- Collaborate with internal teams to provide market trend analysis.
- Develop and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and partners.
- Ensure business continuity and risk mitigation strategies are in place.

- At least 3-4 years of sourcing experience, especially in components.
- High proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
- Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
- Ability to work globally across regions (US, EMEA, AP).

The Role
As the Data Analytics & Insights Manager, you will bridge complex data to strategic action for our Direct-to-Consumer (DTX) eCommerce business. This is a high-impact role, supporting websites in 40 global markets and the ways we engage and build relationships with our consumers. It is equal parts data expertise and excellent communication, working closely with business partners to leverage data and insights to drive business decisions.

You will lead a team of analysts to move beyond reactive reporting to provide proactive, high-value insights that optimize front-end site performance, marketing efficiency, and the overall consumer experience.

Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Strategic Partnership
• Lead a team of 3–4 internal data analysts and external agency resources to deliver insights to business partners.

• Build a culture and practice of proactive business partnering, serving as data partners to Website Product & Design, Digital Content, Marketing & Category, and Consumer Insight teams to drive data-informed decision-making.

• Ensure insights are actionable and commercially relevant for stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy.

• Guide prioritization of requests and initiatives across the team.

• Drive Global Scalability, establishing standards for scalable analytical approaches where possible (e.g., marketing campaign reporting).

• Reporting and Visualization - create and maintain dynamic dashboards on Tableau and automated reports to track key performance indicators for senior leadership and business partners.

• Data Compliance, ensuring data practices comply with legal, privacy, and regulatory practices.

Technical Strategy & AI Innovation
• Develop and execute the AI strategy for the analytics workflow to increase team efficiency and move toward predictive capabilities, partnering with our Digital Office to develop AI solutions.

• Utilize Adobe Analytics, Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) and other data sources to understand the end-to-end consumer journey.

• Partner with the Digital Growth Solutions team to ensure data layer integrity and governance across Snowflake, Tableau, and other core infrastructure.

Focus Areas for Insights
• Site Performance: Partner with Product and UX team to analyze conversion flows, engagement, and feature effectiveness.

• Consumer Insights: Manage and interpret sentiment data via CDP/CRM platforms, NPS, on-site surveys and other sources of consumer feedback..

• Marketing & Category: Provide deep-dive analysis on marketing campaigns, New Product Introductions (NPIs), lifecycle marketing (CRM) and customer segments.

• Site Content: Evaluate content engagement and efficacy across the site and consumer journey.

Qualifications

• Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data trends to a Brand Manager or Creative Director without using jargon. You are a storyteller who uses data as your script.

• SQL proficiency. Ability to write and optimize queries within a data warehouse (Snowflake), to join disparate data sources for platform-agnostic analysis (e.g., matching CRM data with web behavior)

• 5–7 years experience in eCommerce analytics, with specific proficiency in Adobe Analytics and Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

• Experience working within a global organization, understanding the nuances of localized market data.

• Proven experience managing direct reports and agencies, with a track record of leveling up team members' skills.

Logitech è il Sweet Spot per le persone che vogliono che le loro azioni abbiano un impatto globale positivo, pur avendo la flessibilità di farlo a modo loro.

Il ruolo
In qualità di Data Analytics & Insights Manager, collaborerai dati complessi ad azioni strategiche per il nostro business eCommerce Direct-to-Consumer (DTX). Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto, sostenendo i siti web in 40 mercati globali e i modi in cui ci impegniamo e costruiamo relazioni con i nostri consumatori. È l'esperienza dei dati di parti uguali e la comunicazione eccellente, lavorando a stretto contatto con i partner commerciali per sfruttare i dati e le intuizioni per guidare le decisioni aziendali.

Condurrai un team di analisti a passare oltre i report reattivi per fornire intuizioni proattive e ad alto valore che ottimizzano le prestazioni del sito di front-end, l'efficienza di marketing e l'esperienza generale del consumatore.

Principali responsabilità
Leadership e partenariato strategico
• Guidare un team di 3–4 analisti di dati interni e risorse di agenzia esterna per fornire informazioni ai partner commerciali.

• Costruire una cultura e la pratica del business partner proattivo, servendo come partner di dati per il sito Web Product & Design, i contenuti digitali, Marketing & Categoria e i team di Consumer Insight per guidare il processo decisionale informato dei dati.

• Assicurarsi che le informazioni siano attuabili e commercialmente rilevanti per le parti interessate con vari livelli di alfabetizzazione dei dati.

• Guida prioritaria di richieste e iniziative in tutto il team.

• Guidare la scalabilità globale, stabilire standard per approcci analitici scalabili ove possibile (ad esempio, reporting campagna di marketing).

• Reporting e Visualization - creare e mantenere cruscotti dinamici su Tableau e report automatizzati per monitorare gli indicatori di performance chiave per senior leadership e partner commerciali.

• Compliance dei dati, assicurando che le pratiche dei dati siano conformi alle pratiche legali, privacy e regolamentari.

Strategia tecnica e innovazione AI
• Sviluppare ed eseguire la strategia AI per il flusso di lavoro di analisi per aumentare l'efficienza del team e muoversi verso le capacità predittive, collaborando con il nostro Digital Office per sviluppare soluzioni AI.

• Utilizza Adobe Analytics, Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) e altre fonti di dati per comprendere il viaggio end-to-end dei consumatori.

• Partner del team Digital Growth Solutions per garantire l'integrità e la governance dei livelli di dati attraverso Snowflake, Tableau e altre infrastrutture di base.

Aree di messa a fuoco per Insights
• Performance del sito: Partner con il team di prodotto e UX per analizzare i flussi di conversione, il coinvolgimento e l'efficacia della funzionalità.

• Consumer Insights: gestire e interpretare i dati del sentimento tramite piattaforme CDP/CRM, NPS, sondaggi in loco e altre fonti di feedback dei consumatori.

• Marketing & Categoria: Fornire analisi approfondite sulle campagne di marketing, nuove introduzioni di prodotto (NPI), il marketing del ciclo di vita (CRM) e i segmenti dei clienti.

• Contenuto del sito: valutare l'impegno e l'efficacia dei contenuti attraverso il sito e il viaggio dei consumatori.

Qualifiche

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione. È possibile spiegare complesse tendenze di dati a un Brand Manager o Direttore Creativo senza utilizzare Jargon. Sei un narratore che utilizza i dati come script.

• Competenza SQL. Capacità di scrivere e ottimizzare le domande all'interno di un data warehouse (Snowflake), per unire fonti di dati disparate per l'analisi della piattaforma-agnostica (ad esempio, corrispondenti dati CRM con il comportamento web)

• Esperienza di 5-7 anni nell'analisi dell'eCommerce, con competenza specifica in Adobe Analytics e Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un'organizzazione globale, comprensione delle sfumature dei dati di mercato localizzati.

• Provata esperienza nella gestione di report e agenzie dirette, con un track record di livellamento delle competenze dei membri del team.

• Familiarità con lo stack di dati moderno (Snowflake, Tableau) e una chiara visione di come l'intelligenza artificiale possa trasformare l'analisi dei dati.

• Laurea in Business, Data Analytics, Data Science o relativo campo. Laurea magistrale preferita.

Technical Project Manager Job Description

You are passionate about products and delivering amazing experiences to enhance the life of millions of people as they interact everyday with digital content.

Your Contribution
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and Just Do. These are the behaviors you'll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Manage and coordinate New Product Introduction (NPI) development through the product life cycle process from concept to product delivery - apply project management standards.

• Lead the MKS strategic direction of ESW (Embedded Software) activities, ensuring seamless alignment and cross-functional integration between ESW, software, hardware, and design teams to deliver superior user experiences.

• Drive the practical application of AI/ML technologies by leading both the integration of intelligent features into device ESW and the adoption of AI-driven tools to optimize internal development workflows.

• Partner with Product Management, Hardware and Software Engineering, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to deliver projects on time within defined expectations in terms of experience, cost and quality.

• Collaborate with Product Management, Design, Hardware and Software Engineering and Operations to explore and deliver the technical bricks for the needs of the roadmap.

• Lead and staff a project team - multi-functions and multi-sites (worldwide).

• Identify, evaluate and escalate the risks associated with project activities and take appropriate actions to control the risks and to drive solutions.

• Synthesize data and information related to scope or risks change.

• Collaborate with Functional Manager to improve project organization, efficiency (tools, processes) and time to market.

• Ensure that project activities operate within the policies and processes of the organization.

Key Qualifications

• Essential Knowledge of AI/ML: Practical experience with AI frameworks and platforms on both Host and Device sides (e.g., EdgeAI, TinyML) is required to support our AI-driven team transformation and ESW integration.

• Minimum 7 years of project management experience in a high-tech environment with a cross-functional and global team managing with involvement from initial concept through product delivery with stable manufacturing.

• Strong cross-functional knowledge in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, and Embedded Software.

• Expertise developing sustainable products is a plus.

• Deep knowledge of project management standards & methodology.

• Independent. Design Thinking Knowledge and application. Creative mindset.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, multi-site development teams, cross-functional teams including marketing and business interfaces.

• Strong organizational, excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to work across organizations and geographies.

• Faculty to interact, influence, and negotiate effectively with all levels of management.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks, activities, projects, and sustaining projects.

• Ability to travel - Domestic on a regular basis and Intercontinental based on project events.

• Good understanding of working with a functional team in a Global Environment.

• Ability to develop a comprehensive project development timeline and risk tracking overview by using proper tools.

• Formal Project Management training and Certification (PMP).

• Software / Embedded software background or management experience is a plus.

• Prior experience leading AI/ML product integration in embedded high-tech environments.

• Passion for technologies and innovation.

• Team Spirit.

• Creative.

• Entrepreneurial mindset.

• Autonomous, curious, reliable.

• Looking for new challenges.

Education

• Bachelor or Master degree in Engineering.

Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Sii te stesso. Sii aperto. Restate a Hungry e Humble. Collaborate. Sfida. Decidi e basta. Questi sono i comportamenti di cui avrete bisogno per il successo a Logitech.

Inoltre, questo ruolo gestirà il processo di erogazione delle imposte sul reddito per gli enti legali svizzeri. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla tassazione diretta delle imprese.
Questo è un ruolo temporaneo per coprire un congedo previsto, per un periodo di otto-nove mesi.
Durata del contratto prevista: novembre 2026 – luglio 2027

Il tuo contributo

Sii te stesso. Sii aperto. Restate a Hungry e Humble. Collaborate. Sfida. Condividi la nostra passione per l'uguaglianza e l'ambiente. Questi sono i comportamenti e i valori di cui avrete bisogno per il successo a Logitech. In questo ruolo sarete:

• Preparare e gestire le imposte dirette sul reddito svizzero, le imposte sui capitali e il rispetto delle imposte.

• Preparare i calcoli dell'imposta sul reddito in conformità con ASC 740 e fornire input per la divulgazione fiscale nel bilancio legale rispetto agli enti svizzeri.

• Sostenere la pianificazione fiscale strategica (comprese le strategie per gestire l'impatto legato al Pillar2) e identificare e mitigare l'esposizione fiscale diretta in Svizzera.

• Progetti correlati all'imposta di piombo attraverso una collaborazione efficace con team di finanza e altri dipartimenti in più siti. Supporta la migrazione in un ambiente ERP moderno (ad esempio Oracle Cloud).

• Consultare gli audit e le ispezioni, fornire informazioni come richiesto dalle autorità fiscali e raccomandazioni per la risoluzione delle controversie.

• Assistere nella dovuta diligenza e pianificazione fiscale relativa a fusioni e acquisizioni e operazioni aziendali come necessario.

• Identificare e implementare iniziative di miglioramento/automazione del processo per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia dei processi fiscali.

• Assicurare il completamento tempestivo di vari depositi fiscali in Svizzera, direttamente o in consultazione con i fornitori di servizi esterni.

• Gestire l'imposta sul reddito e altri pagamenti fiscali (ad esempio, tasse di trasferimento, dazi) per gli enti legali in Svizzera.

• Lavorare con una rete di partner commerciali interni (contabilità, FP&A, team commerciali e gruppo fiscale globale) e consulenti esterni e fornitori di servizi

• Un minimo di 7+ anni di esperienza fiscale aziendale. L'esperienza come responsabile fiscale interno nel dipartimento fiscale regionale di un gruppo multinazionale è un vantaggio. Esperienza di Big4 preferita.

• Esperienza con le attività di compliance fiscale per le aziende multinazionali svizzere..

• Solida comprensione dell'imposta sul reddito, dell'imposta sul capitale e della ritenuta alla fonte.

• L'esperienza con la contabilità trimestrale delle imposte sul reddito, la segnalazione e la divulgazione in conformità con US GAAP è un plus

• BA/BS in Business/Accounting o equivalente; Master's Degree in Taxation preferito

• Un self-starter con una forte conoscenza tecnica dei principi fiscali sul reddito aziendale

• Dettaglio e proattivo, in grado di gestire più priorità e rispettare scadenze rigorose

Working with a degree of autonomy and supported by regular mentorship from senior leadership, you will bridge the gap between compliance, employee experience, and talent community engagement. Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will work on:

• Education: Recently completed a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Swiss Law, or a related field.

• Swiss Market Knowledge: Good understanding of Swiss labor law principles and Swiss work permit categories is strongly preferred.

• Project Ownership: Ability to take initiative, structure unstructured tasks, and execute projects end-to-end with minimal supervision.

• Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent interpersonal skills to interact professionally across all organizational levels.
